scripts.gen:api: uv run --directory server python -m forms_pilot.export_openapi openapi.json && pnpm --filter @forms-pilot/extension gen:api
scripts.typecheck: pnpm gen:api && pnpm -r typecheck && uv run --directory server basedpyright
scripts.test: pnpm -r --if-present test && uv run --directory server pytest -q
scripts.lint:python: uv run --directory server ruff check . && uv run --directory server ruff format --check .
